from collections import Counter
H=len(inp); W=30
bg=9
def solve(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            nb=[g[r+dr][c] for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W]
            if nb and v!=Counter(nb).most_common(1)[0][0]:
                # noise: majority neighbor, tie -> least frequent color overall
                m=Counter(nb); mx=max(m.values()); cand=[k for k in m if m[k]==mx]
                pick=min(cand,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
                g[r][c]=pick
    return g
res=solve(inp)
print(res==out)
bad=[(r,c,inp[r][c],res[r][c],out[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if res[r][c]!=out[r][c]]
for b in bad: print(b)

def solve(g,bg):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    noise=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if g[r][c]!=bg
           and all(g[r+dr][c+dc]!=g[r][c] for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W)]
    for r,c in noise:
        nb=[g[r+dr][c+dc] for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W]
        m=Counter(nb); mx=max(m.values()); cand=[k for k in m if m[k]==mx]
        g[r][c]=min(cand,key=lambda k:cnt[k]) if len(cand)>1 else cand[0]
    return g
